text.en: At 10 stacks of Rewind Again, a small portal will open, shooting bullets from an alternate timeline version of this weapon. Precision hits extend the portal's duration.
At 10 stacks of Rewind Again, a small portal will open, shooting bullets from an alternate timeline version of this weapon. Precision hits extend the portal's duration.

Each Precision Hit or Hit against a <stasis/>Stasis-Debuffed target grants 1 stack of 'Rewind Again'. Maximum of 10 stacks.

At 10 stacks, summon a 'Time-Slip Portal' that hovers next to you and fires a three-round burst every 1.25 seconds, each bullet dealing <pve 46.1 /> <pvp [10.2] /> damage.

Time-Slip Portal has a range of 40 meters, experiences no damage falloff, and inherits the weapon's <link Combatant Damage Scaling [#CombatantScaling] />.

Stowing the weapon removes your Time-Slip Portal.
